insight: Fraunces and Plus Jakarta Sans are now flagged by the impeccable anti-slop detector as overused AI-generated-UI defaults, despite being in design-consultation's own recommended font list. When impeccable flags a font the skill itself recommended, trust impeccable (more current signal) and swap to a less-common alternative with the same character.

When a product has a dual-accent authorship color system (human vs AI-touched), any multiplayer/collaborator color palette must explicitly exclude the AI accent hue from the human hash pool, or a human collaborator could visually be mistaken for the AI presence. Chapters resolved this by giving AI the exclusive teal accent as its live cursor color too.
